cli.usage:
Usage: sevdesk-mcp [command]

Without a command, starts the MCP server on stdio.

Commands:
  setup      Store a sevDesk API token and register MCP clients
  --help     Show this help
  --version  Show the version

Exit codes:
  {success}  Success
  {failure}  Error while running
  {usage}  Usage error (unknown command or option)
setup.notImplemented: The setup assistant is not implemented yet.
